forbidden: No VWAP as primary, no DVP clone, no EMA/RSI/FVG/volume-profile/ORB/sweep/DOM/MBP/MBO/TSMOM/news-alpha, no Fibonacci 0.618 search, no holdout tuning, no indicator soup, no freeze.

distinct_from_dvp.dvp: 15m hour-return AND session VWAP drift, then opposing 1m candle, fixed 80-pt stop, trade window 10:30-15:30
distinct_from_dvp.phase42: Completed 1h/4h return regime without VWAP, first RTH retracement of session impulse vs 09:30 open, 5m confirmation, stop at pullback extreme. VWAP recorded only as diagnostic.

1h.alignment: America/New_York clock hours (bucket start :00). Bar.time is bucket open. Close time = open + 3600. Unfinished hour omitted.
1h.return: close of last completed 1h / close of the 1h bar four intervals earlier - 1. Requires 5 completed 1h closes.

4h.return: close of last completed 4h / close of the 4h bar three intervals earlier - 1. Requires 4 completed 4h closes.

htf.leak: Decision at time T uses only HTF bars whose close_ts <= T. Current unfinished HTF bar is never used.
htf.threshold_locked: 0.20% predeclared from the research brief. Not chosen from P&L. TRAIN distribution is reported as feasibility only.

impulse.bullish: impulse_high = running RTH high since 09:30; impulse_anchor = 09:30 open; retracement = (impulse_high - 5m_low) / (impulse_high - open)
impulse.bearish: impulse_low = running RTH low since 09:30; impulse_anchor = 09:30 open; retracement = (5m_high - impulse_low) / (open - impulse_low)
impulse.note: No ICT swings. No 15m discretionary labeling. Impulse must exist in the trend direction (high > open for longs, low < open for shorts).

primary_candidate.rules: 1h trend from completed bars only at each 5m decision. Wait for the first 5m bar whose retracement vs session impulse lands in the medium bucket [40%, 60%]. After that tagging bar, first completed 5m candle in the trend direction (long: close>open; short: close<open). Enter the next 5m open +/- 1 tick. Stop = pullback extreme from tag through confirm +/- 1 tick. Target = 1R (0.5/1.5/2/3R tracked independently). Flatten 15:55. Max 1 trade/day. Same-bar stop+target on 1m path = AMBIGUOUS. If retracement exceeds 75% before confirm, cancel. If HTF leaves the required side before confirm, cancel.
primary_candidate.reason: Locked before Phase 42 P&L. Tests whether a 1h directional regime plus first medium pullback plus simple 5m continuation can be monetized.

secondary_candidates.rules: Same 1h trend and first medium pullback. Confirmation = first subsequent 5m that breaks the prior 5m high (long) or prior 5m low (short). Enter next 5m open.
Same pullback and 5m candle confirmation, but regime is completed 4h return over prior 3 intervals at +/- 0.20%.

atr_robustness.note: Diagnostic only. Not a third family.
atr_robustness.atr: 14-bar ATR of completed 5m bars at decision time. Bullish: pullback from session high >= k*ATR.

chrono.note: Predeclared. Same split as Phase 38/39/41. No holdout tuning.

news.default: T-5m to T+5m around 08:30 never overlaps RTH entries after 09:30.
news.1000_et: No complete 10:00 calendar in-repo. Do not invent a daily 09:55-10:05 filter. Report as limitation.

vwap: Diagnostic only. If the candidate requires VWAP alignment to work, treat as DVP-like and do not promote.
note: Phase 42 does not freeze. Candidate JSON only if HTF_PULLBACK_EDGE_FOUND.
